body:
Generated bytecode is indeed wrong:

```
  public java.util.List findAll();
    descriptor: ()Ljava/util/List;
    flags: ACC_PUBLIC
    Code:
      stack=1, locals=1, args_size=1
         0: aload_0
         1: invokevirtual #21                 // Method delegate:()Lorg/jboss/shamrock/example/panache/PersonDao;
         4: checkcast     #23                 // class org/jboss/panache/DaoBase
         7: invokevirtual #35                 // Method org/jboss/panache/DaoBase.findAll:()Ljava/util/List;
        10: areturn
```

I'm pretty sure we should be calling `findAll()` on `PersonDao` not its superinterface. I'll try to fix this as it's blocking me.

So I have the start of a fix in https://github.com/FroMage/protean-shamrock/commit/7ce5d086a041d3ac6cf361d4c1a99f5ecef06a65 but there are two further cases that I haven't tried: reflection, and interface.
@mkouba you have tests for this proxy behaviour I can add somewhere?
This is implemented and tested in #719
